paragraphs.text: Sutina was a legendary elf scout from Zendikar during the time of the Eldrazi awakening.
Those who think the trees shall remain bystanders throughout this conflict shall be sorely mistaken.

Sutina was a character who was originally mentioned in Rise of the Eldrazi before later debuting as a card in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Green Landfall deck . She was the Speaker of the Tajuru nation of elves and ruled from the Tumbled Palace on the cliffs of Sunder Bay . She had a special connection with the monstrous octopus Lorthos and was the closest friend of the kraken Brinelin . She was slain by Eldrazi during the early days of their awakening, the very first time Nissa Revane encountered them.
